generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Equisetaceae and Equisetum: rhizomatous herbs with hollow, jointed aerial stems, sometimes unbranched, stiffened with silica and without secondary thickening; leaves a whorl of teeth joined into a sheath, mostly without chlorophyll, the stems doing the photosynthesis; sporangia in terminal cones.

traits.leaf_form.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 96, family Equisetaceae: leaf form scale; read as "scale".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 96, family Equisetaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.sporangia.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 96, family Equisetaceae: sporangia cones; read as "cones".

traits.reproduction.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 96, family Equisetaceae: reproduction spores; read as "spores".

traits.clonal.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 96, family Equisetaceae: clonal true (extensive colonies), often; read as {"true": "usually"}.
